desese_description: Acne is a skin condition characterized by pimples, blackheads, and inflammation caused by blocked hair follicles and excess sebum.

desese_description: Vitiligo is a chronic skin condition characterized by loss of pigmentation leading to white patches on the skin.

followup.note: Monitor skin lesions and nerve function.

desese_description: Leprosy is a chronic infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium leprae, affecting skin, nerves, and eyes.

followup.note: Check for persistent itching or reinfection.

desese_description: Scabies is a contagious skin infestation caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei, leading to intense itching and rash.

name: Ringworm

diet: No specific restrictions; maintain hygiene.

followup.note: Monitor for clearing of lesions.

desese_description: Ringworm is a fungal infection of the skin, hair, or nails, characterized by red, circular, itchy rashes.

name: Conjunctivitis

diet: No specific restrictions.

followup.note: Check for resolution of redness and discharge.

desese_description: Conjunctivitis is inflammation of the conjunctiva, causing red, itchy, and watery eyes, often due to infection or allergies.

name: Glaucoma

followup.note: Monitor vision changes and eye pressure.

desese_description: Glaucoma is a group of eye disorders causing damage to the optic nerve, leading to progressive vision loss, often linked to increased intraocular pressure.

name: Cataract

followup.note: Monitor visual improvement post-surgery.

desese_description: Cataract is clouding of the eye's natural lens, leading to blurred vision, glare, and difficulty seeing, especially at night.

name: Otitis Media

desese_description: Obesity is a chronic condition of excess body fat that increases the risk of heart disease, diabetes, and other health problems.

name: Stroke

followup.note: Monitor recovery and prevent recurrence.

desese_description: Stroke occurs when blood flow to the brain is interrupted, causing neurological deficits; early treatment is critical to reduce long-term damage.

name: Heart Attack

followup.note: Monitor recovery and cardiac function.

name: Heart Failure

diet: Low-salt, fluid-controlled, heart-healthy diet.

followup.note: Monitor fluid status and cardiac function.

desese_description: Heart Failure is a chronic condition where the heart cannot pump blood efficiently, causing fatigue, fluid retention, and shortness of breath.

name: Coronary Artery Disease

diet: Heart-healthy diet low in saturated fats and sodium.

followup.note: Monitor cardiovascular health and risk factors.

desese_description: Coronary Artery Disease occurs when the coronary arteries are narrowed or blocked, reducing blood flow to the heart muscle.

name: Thyroid Disorder

diet: Balanced diet; avoid excessive iodine if hyperthyroid.

followup.note: Monitor thyroid hormone levels regularly.

desese_description: Thyroid disorders affect hormone production, causing symptoms like fatigue, weight changes, and metabolic disturbances.

name: Hypothyroidism

medicines.notes: Educate about condition and treatment adherence

diet: Include iodine-rich foods; maintain a balanced diet.

followup.note: Monitor hormone levels and adjust dose.

desese_description: Hypothyroidism is a condition where the thyroid gland does not produce enough hormones, leading to fatigue, weight gain, and metabolic slowdown.

name: PCOS

diet: Balanced low-glycemic diet; maintain healthy weight.

followup.note: Monitor hormone levels and ovulation cycles.

desese_description: PCOS is a hormonal disorder causing irregular periods, cysts in ovaries, excess hair growth, and fertility issues.

name: Endometriosis

diet: Anti-inflammatory diet recommended; avoid high-fat processed foods.

followup.note: Monitor pain and fertility status.

desese_description: Endometriosis is a condition where tissue similar to the uterine lining grows outside the uterus, causing pain and fertility issues.

name: Preeclampsia

medication: Control blood pressure, prevent seizures, and manage complications; delivery is definitive treatment.
diet: Low-salt, healthy diet; stay hydrated.

followup.note: Frequent maternal and fetal monitoring required.

desese_description: Preeclampsia is a pregnancy complication characterized by high blood pressure and signs of organ damage, potentially dangerous for mother and baby.

name: Osteoporosis

diet: Calcium- and vitamin D-rich foods; maintain healthy weight.

followup.note: Repeat bone density scan annually.

desese_description: Osteoporosis is a condition where bones become weak and brittle, increasing fracture risk.

name: Rheumatoid Arthritis

medicines.notes: Check blood markers and joint function

diet: Anti-inflammatory diet, rich in omega-3 fatty acids.

followup.note: Monitor inflammation markers and joint function regularly.

desese_description: Rheumatoid arthritis is an autoimmune disease causing chronic inflammation of joints, leading to pain and deformities.

name: Gout
medication: Manage pain and uric acid levels; prevent recurrent attacks with lifestyle changes and medications.
diet: Low-purine diet, adequate hydration, avoid alcohol.

followup.note: Monitor uric acid levels and joint health.

desese_description: Gout is a type of arthritis caused by excess uric acid leading to painful joint inflammation.

name: Leukemia

medicines.name: Regular Monitoring
medicines.notes: Blood counts and bone marrow evaluation

medication: Chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and supportive care to manage leukemia.
diet: High-protein, nutrient-rich diet to maintain strength during treatment.

followup.note: Monitor blood counts and organ function.

desese_description: Leukemia is a type of blood cancer affecting white blood cells, leading to fatigue, infections, and bleeding.

name: Lymphoma

medicines.notes: Check blood counts and lymph node response

diet: High-protein, nutrient-rich diet; avoid infections.

followup.note: Monitor lymph node size and blood counts.

desese_description: Lymphoma is a type of cancer affecting the lymphatic system, leading to swollen nodes, fever, and fatigue.

name: Breast Cancer

diet: Balanced, nutrient-rich diet to support treatment and immunity.

followup.note: Monitor treatment response and tumor markers regularly.

desese_description: Breast cancer is a malignant tumor originating from breast tissue, potentially spreading to lymph nodes and other organs.

name: Lung Cancer

medicines.name: Regular Monitoring
medicines.notes: CT scan, blood tests and pulmonary function tests

medication: Surgery, chemotherapy, radiation, targeted therapy, and immunotherapy to treat lung cancer depending on type and stage.
diet: Balanced diet rich in proteins and antioxidants to support treatment.

followup.note: Regular imaging and lab tests to monitor tumor progression.

desese_description: Lung cancer is a malignant tumor in lung tissue that can spread to other parts of the body if untreated.

name: Skin Cancer

medicines.notes: Uses light to destroy cancer cells

diet: Balanced diet with antioxidants to support healing and immunity.

followup.note: Monthly skin checks for early detection of recurrence.

desese_description: Skin cancer is an abnormal growth of skin cells, often caused by UV exposure, which can spread if untreated.

medicines.notes: Reduces testosterone to slow cancer growth

medicines.name: Regular Monitoring
medicines.notes: PSA tests and imaging to monitor progression

diet: Balanced diet rich in proteins, fruits, and vegetables to support recovery and immunity.

followup.note: PSA monitoring and imaging for disease progression.

desese_description: Prostate cancer is a malignant tumor of the prostate gland, affecting urinary and reproductive functions.

name: Cervical Cancer

medicines.name: Dietary Support
medicines.notes: Balanced diet with vitamins and proteins

medicines.name: Regular Monitoring
medicines.notes: Pap smear, HPV testing, imaging for recurrence

medication: Surgery, chemotherapy, radiation, targeted therapy, and immunotherapy depending on stage and tumor characteristics.
diet: Balanced diet with adequate protein, vitamins, and minerals to support treatment.

followup.note: Regular Pap smear, HPV test, and imaging to monitor for recurrence.

desese_description: Cervical cancer is a malignant tumor of the cervix, often caused by HPV infection, which can spread to adjacent tissues if untreated.

name: Bladder Infection
medication: Antibiotics and supportive care depending on severity.
diet: Increase fluid intake and avoid irritants like caffeine.

followup.note: Ensure symptoms resolve and follow-up urine tests if needed.

desese_description: Bladder infection, or cystitis, is a bacterial infection of the bladder causing pain, frequent urination, and urgency.

name: Urinary Tract Infection
medication: Antibiotics depending on bacteria type, plus supportive care.
diet: Plenty of fluids, avoid irritants like caffeine and alcohol.

followup.note: Ensure complete resolution of symptoms.

desese_description: Urinary tract infection (UTI) is a bacterial infection affecting any part of the urinary system, causing pain and frequent urination.

name: Sepsis
medication: Immediate IV antibiotics and supportive care are essential to prevent organ failure.
diet: Maintain hydration and balanced nutrition, consider tube feeding if necessary.

followup.note: Continuous monitoring until full recovery.

desese_description: Sepsis is a life-threatening condition caused by the body's extreme response to an infection, leading to organ dysfunction and shock.

name: Meningitis
medication: Prompt IV antibiotics and corticosteroids are required to prevent complications.
diet: Ensure hydration and nutrition to support recovery.

followup.note: Monitor for neurological complications and full recovery.

desese_description: Meningitis is an inflammation of the protective membranes covering the brain and spinal cord, usually caused by infection, leading to severe headache, fever, and neck stiffness.

name: Encephalitis
medication: Antiviral treatment and corticosteroids with supportive therapy.
diet: High-protein, easy-to-digest meals with adequate hydration.

followup.note: Neurological rehabilitation and MRI follow-up.

desese_description: Encephalitis is an inflammation of the brain tissue, usually caused by viral infections, leading to seizures, confusion, and neurological damage.

name: Whooping Cough
medication: Macrolide antibiotics like Azithromycin with symptomatic care.
diet: Soft foods, fluids, and honey for throat soothing.

followup.note: Monitor breathing and cough frequency.

desese_description: Whooping cough is a contagious respiratory infection causing violent coughing fits, often ending with a 'whoop' sound.

name: Scarlet Fever
medication: Antibiotics and supportive treatment to prevent complications.
diet: Soft foods, warm liquids, avoid spicy items.

followup.note: Ensure rash resolves and check for kidney involvement.

desese_description: Scarlet fever is a bacterial illness caused by group A Streptococcus, characterized by a red rash and sore throat.

name: Tetanus

medicines.name: Follow-up
medicines.notes: Ensure wound healing and muscle recovery

medication: Antitoxin and antibiotics along with supportive therapy.
diet: Soft foods and fluids during muscle recovery.

followup.note: Monitor for muscle stiffness improvement.

desese_description: Tetanus is a bacterial infection causing muscle stiffness and spasms due to a toxin released by *Clostridium tetani*.

name: Rabies
medication: Immediate vaccination and immunoglobulin administration are life-saving.
diet: Soft food and fluids; avoid alcohol.

followup.note: Ensure vaccine series completion.

desese_description: Rabies is a deadly viral disease transmitted through animal bites, affecting the brain and nervous system.

name: Ebola
medication: Supportive therapy and experimental antivirals under medical supervision.
diet: High-fluid, high-protein, vitamin-rich meals.

followup.note: Monitor for relapse and organ recovery.

desese_description: Ebola is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever causing internal and external bleeding with high fatality rate.

name: Zika Virus
medication: Supportive care with antipyretics, fluids, and rest.
diet: Light, nutritious diet with plenty of fluids and fruits.

followup.note: Check for neurological or pregnancy-related complications.

desese_description: Zika virus is a mosquito-borne infection causing fever, rash, and joint pain, with potential complications in pregnancy.

name: Monkeypox
medication: Supportive care and antiviral therapy with Tecovirimat.
diet: Soft diet, fluids, avoid spicy or fried food.

followup.note: Ensure full recovery and lesion healing.

desese_description: Monkeypox is a viral zoonotic disease causing fever, rash, and pustular lesions similar to smallpox but less severe.

name: Chikungunya
medication: Supportive care with fluids and pain relief.
diet: Nutritious meals with fruits and adequate hydration.

followup.note: Monitor persistent joint pain.

desese_description: Chikungunya is a mosquito-borne viral infection causing sudden fever and severe joint pain.

name: Yellow Fever
medication: Supportive therapy; no specific antiviral treatment.
diet: Soft diet, fruits, hydration, avoid alcohol.

followup.note: Check liver recovery and jaundice improvement.

desese_description: Yellow fever is a viral infection transmitted by mosquitoes, causing fever, jaundice, and bleeding tendencies.

name: Diphtheria
medication: Antitoxin + antibiotics (penicillin or macrolide) with airway and supportive care.
diet: Soft, easy-to-swallow foods and adequate fluids during recovery.

followup.note: Monitor for cardiac and neurological complications.

desese_description: Diphtheria is a bacterial, toxin-mediated disease causing throat membrane formation and systemic complications; prompt antitoxin and antibiotics are critical.

name: Polio
medication: No specific antiviral; supportive care, respiratory support, and rehabilitation are mainstays.
diet: High-protein, calorie-dense diet to support recovery and muscle strength.
duration: Acute management, long-term rehab if paralysis occurs

followup.note: Long-term neurologic and rehabilitation follow-up for residual paralysis.

desese_description: Polio is a viral disease that can cause irreversible flaccid paralysis; vaccination is the primary prevention.

name: Smallpox
medication: Primarily supportive; antivirals (e.g., tecovirimat) and immune therapies under outbreak protocols.
diet: Nutrient-rich, high-calorie diet to support healing; maintain hydration.

followup.note: Monitor for scarring and sequelae; public health follow-up mandatory.

desese_description: Smallpox is a serious viral disease eradicated by vaccination; treatment is supportive and antivirals are used only under special protocols.

name: Plague
symptoms: Peripheral lymph node swelling (buboes) - bubonic form

medicines.name: Doxycycline
medicines.notes: Used in less severe cases or prophylaxis

medication: Prompt effective antibiotics (aminoglycosides or doxycycline/ciprofloxacin) and supportive care; isolation for pneumonic form.
diet: Maintain hydration and nutritious diet; small frequent meals if ill.

followup.note: Monitor for complications and ensure contacts receive prophylaxis.

desese_description: Plague is a serious bacterial disease with bubonic, pneumonic, and septicemic forms; early antibiotics dramatically reduce mortality.

name: Filariasis

medicines.name: Ivermectin
medicines.frequency: Single dose or as per protocol

medicines.name: Albendazole
medicines.frequency: Single dose or bd with DEC

medicines.name: Community MDA Programs
medicines.notes: Mass drug administration to eliminate transmission

medication: Antiparasitic agents (DEC, ivermectin, albendazole) plus doxycycline in some regimens; lymphedema care.
diet: Balanced diet to support immunity; maintain skin hygiene and nutrition.
duration: Single to multi-day courses; long-term lymphedema care

followup.note: Monitor microfilarial clearance and manage lymphedema complications.

desese_description: Filariasis is a mosquito-transmitted parasitic disease causing lymphatic damage and chronic swelling (elephantiasis); mass treatment programs reduce transmission.

name: Hookworm Infection

medicines.name: Mebendazole
medicines.frequency: Single dose or twice daily for 3 days

medication: Single-dose albendazole or mebendazole; treat anemia and provide nutrition support.
diet: Iron-rich, protein-rich foods; maintain hydration and good nutrition.
duration: 1-3 days for anthelmintic; anemia treatment longer

followup.note: Repeat stool exam and check hemoglobin to ensure cure.

desese_description: Hookworm infection is caused by soil-transmitted nematodes that enter through the skin and can cause chronic blood loss and anemia.

name: Tapeworm Infection

medicines.name: Corticosteroids (to reduce inflammation in cystic disease)
Surgical removal (if large cysts or complications)
medicines.notes: For hydatid cysts or obstructive lesions

medicines.name: Hygiene and Food Safety
medicines.notes: Prevent reinfection by proper cooking and sanitation

medication: Praziquantel for intestinal tapeworms; albendazole ± surgery for tissue/cystic disease; supportive care for complications.
diet: Cook meat thoroughly, maintain food hygiene; nutrient-rich diet to correct deficiencies.
frequency: Single course or multi-day depending on disease
duration: Single dose to several weeks; follow-up required

followup.note: Repeat stool exam and imaging as indicated to confirm cure.

desese_description: Tapeworm infections are parasitic diseases acquired from undercooked meat or contaminated food; some species can form tissue cysts causing serious complications.

name: Ascariasis
medication: Albendazole or Mebendazole for deworming.
diet: High-protein diet with clean, cooked food. Avoid raw vegetables.

followup.note: Recheck stool sample after treatment.

desese_description: Ascariasis is an intestinal infection caused by roundworms, leading to abdominal pain and malnutrition.

name: Giardiasis

medicines.name: Hygiene Measures
medicines.notes: Use clean water and wash hands

medication: Metronidazole or Tinidazole for 5 days.
diet: Avoid dairy; eat light, low-fat meals.

followup.note: Retest stool after completion of medicine.

desese_description: Giardiasis is an intestinal infection caused by Giardia parasites, leading to diarrhea and malabsorption.

name: Amoebiasis

medicines.name: Dietary Advice
medicines.notes: Avoid street food and unfiltered water

medication: Metronidazole followed by Paromomycin to clear infection.
diet: Light meals, avoid spicy and oily food, drink boiled water.

followup.note: Repeat stool test to confirm recovery.

desese_description: Amoebiasis is a parasitic infection of the intestine caused by Entamoeba histolytica, leading to diarrhea and cramps.

name: Hernia
symptoms: Bulge in the abdomen or groin
Pain after eating or standing long
medication: Painkillers and supportive care before surgery.
diet: High-fiber diet, avoid heavy meals, and maintain healthy weight.

followup.note: Post-surgery wound check and avoid strain.

desese_description: A hernia occurs when an organ pushes through a weak spot in the muscle or tissue, often in the abdomen or groin.

name: Lactose Intolerance
medication: Lactase enzyme tablets before consuming dairy.
diet: Use lactose-free milk; eat yogurt and fortified non-dairy alternatives.

followup.note: Review diet adjustments and calcium levels.

desese_description: Lactose intolerance is the inability to digest lactose due to lactase enzyme deficiency, causing bloating and diarrhea after dairy.

name: Food Poisoning
medication: Antibiotics and rehydration therapy.
diet: Bland diet (rice, banana, toast); avoid spicy or oily food.

followup.note: Re-evaluate hydration and infection control.

desese_description: Food poisoning is caused by consuming contaminated food, leading to vomiting, diarrhea, and dehydration.

name: Dehydration

medicines.name: Medical Attention
medicines.notes: Seek hospital care for persistent vomiting or confusion

medication: ORS and IV fluids depending on severity.
diet: Drink water, coconut water, soups, and fruit juices; avoid alcohol.

followup.note: Check hydration status and electrolyte balance.

desese_description: Dehydration occurs when the body loses more fluids than it takes in, leading to electrolyte imbalance and weakness.
